about.title: About TripleZero iT
about.heroSubtitle: We help entrepreneurs and organisations across Asia, Europe, the UAE and the USA grow with AI, websites, hosting, SEO and marketing — practical, measurable and without unnecessary complexity.
about.missionText: Help businesses with practical AI growth systems — from fast websites and reliable hosting to visibility, conversion and automation that genuinely takes work off your plate.
about.visionText: Build the right digital solution for every entrepreneur — scalable, clear and designed for growth, not trendy tools without outcomes.
about.philosophyText: 000 means zero guesswork, zero shortfall and zero waste: decisions backed by data, enough capacity to grow, and no budget or time spent on what does not work.
about.storyLead: TripleZero iT is your technical growth partner — from the first scan to ongoing optimisation.
about.storyP1: We combine AI integration, AEO, GEO, SEO, web design, WordPress care, hosting and full-funnel marketing in one approach. Your online presence stays fast, secure, findable and focused on leads or revenue.
about.storyP2: Whether it is a bug, malware, migration, performance sprint or a new growth system: we act with focus, explain what is happening and deliver measurable results — so you can focus on your business.
about.storyP3: We work from the Netherlands and Belgium with entrepreneurs, freelancers and SME teams across Asia, Europe, the UAE and the USA that want dependable IT without enterprise overhead.
about.approachSubtitle: Clear steps, short lines of communication and improvements you can measure — no black box.
about.approach1Desc: Map goals, stack and bottlenecks: what is growing, what is blocking, and where AI or optimisation pays off most.
about.approach2Desc: Focused implementation: fixes, features, content, tracking or infrastructure — prioritised by impact.
about.approach3Desc: We track speed, visibility, conversion and stability with concrete signals — not vanity metrics.
about.approach4Desc: Iterate on what works: retention, scale and continuous improvement so growth stays sustainable.
about.whatWeDoSubtitle: One partner for growth, technology and visibility — from AI to hosting.
about.pillarAiDesc: Agents, workflows and AI integrations that accelerate marketing, support and operations.
about.pillarOptDesc: Get found in Google, locally and in AI answers — with content and technical work that ranks.
about.pillarWebDesc: Fast, conversion-focused sites and shops that turn visitors into customers.
about.pillarWpDesc: Bugs, malware, speed, backups and migrations — handled quickly and delivered carefully.
about.pillarHostDesc: Reliable web hosting, WordPress hosting and VPS with support when you need it.
about.pillarMarketDesc: Campaigns, content and social aligned with your funnel and measurable acquisition.
about.pillarDesignDesc: Logos, print and brand assets that fit your digital presence professionally.
about.serveText: Freelancers, startups and established SMEs that want to grow online without an in-house IT or marketing team. You get a clear point of contact, transparent proposals and delivery that matches your pace and budget.
about.why1Desc: Advice that continues into implementation — with clear deliverables and next steps.
about.why2Desc: AI, site, hosting, SEO and marketing reinforce each other instead of living in silos.
about.why3Desc: Short response times, available 7 days a week and monitoring when your environment needs it.
about.readySubtitle: Book a call, start a free AI scan or get in touch — we are happy to map the fastest path to results.
